source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָתֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְהוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and five year[s] became king Amaziah, and twenty and nine year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.

en.L: Amaziah [was] twenty-five years old [when] he became king, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.
en.B: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
en.R: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.

es.L: [Tenía] veinticinco años Amasías cuando comenzó a reinar, y veintinueve años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Joadán, de Jerusalén.
es.B: Amasías tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó veintinueve años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Joadán y era de Jerusalén.
es.R: Amasías tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante veintinueve años. Su madre se llamaba Joadán y era de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Amatsia [avait] vingt-cinq ans [quand] il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Yehoaddân, de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Amatsia avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Yehoaddân ; elle était de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Amatsia avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant vingt-neuf ans. Sa mère s’appelait Yehoaddân ; elle était de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Amazia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka ishirini na tisa alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Yehoadani wa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Amazia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na tisa huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Yehoadani; alikuwa wa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Amazia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka ishirini na tisa. Mama yake aliitwa Yehoadani wa Yerusalemu.

vi.L: A-ma-xia [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ vua [là] Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: A-ma-xia được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì hai mươi chín năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: A-ma-xia được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem hai mươi chín năm. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-hô-a-đan, người Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 아마샤가 왕이 되었을 때 25세[였고], 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 예루살렘 출신 여호앗단이었다.
ko.B: 아마샤는 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 여호앗단이었고, 예루살렘 출신이었다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 25세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 29년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 예루살렘 출신 여호앗단이었다.

pt.L: Amazias [tinha] vinte e cinco anos [quando] começou a reinar, e vinte e nove anos reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Jeoadã, de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Amazias tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e nove anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Jeoadã; ela era de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Amazias tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Governou em Jerusalém durante vinte e nove anos. A mãe dele era Jeoadã, de Jerusalém.

am.L: አሜስያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ አምስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም የኢየሩሳሌም ሰው ዮዓዳን ነበረ።
am.B: አሜስያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው ሃያ አምስት ዓመት ነበር፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም ዮዓዳን ነበረ፤ እርሷም የኢየሩሳሌም ሰው ነበረች።
am.R: አሜስያስ ንጉሥ በሆነ ጊዜ ሃያ አምስት ዓመቱ ነበር፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ገዛ። የእናቱ ስም ዮዓዳን ነበር፤ እርሷም የኢየሩሳሌም ሰው ነበረች።

hi.L: जब अमस्याह राजा बना तब वह पच्चीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में उनतीस वर्ष राज्य किया; उसकी माता का नाम यहोअद्दान था, जो यरूशलेम की थी।
hi.B: जब अमस्याह राजा बना तब वह पच्चीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में उनतीस वर्ष राज्य किया; उसकी माता का नाम यहोअद्दान था, जो यरूशलेम की थी।
hi.R: जब अमस्याह राजा बना, तब वह पच्चीस वर्ष का था। उसने यरूशलेम में उनतीस वर्ष तक राज्य किया। उसकी माता का नाम यहोअद्दान था, जो यरूशलेम की थी।

ru.L: Двадцати пяти лет воцарился Амасия, и двадцать девять лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме; имя его матери — Иегоаддань из Иерусалима.
ru.B: Амасии было двадцать пять лет, когда он воцарился, и двадцать девять лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме; имя его матери — Иегоаддань, она была из Иерусалима.
ru.R: Амасии было двадцать пять лет, когда он стал царём. Он царствовал в Иерусалиме двадцать девять лет. Его мать звали Иегоаддань, она была из Иерусалима.

ja.L: アマツヤは王となったとき二十五歳で、エルサレムで二十九年治めた。彼の母の名はエルサレム出身のヨアダンであった。
ja.B: アマツヤは王となったとき二十五歳で、エルサレムで二十九年間治めた。母の名はヨアダンといい、エルサレムの出身であった。
ja.R: アマツヤは二十五歳で王になり、エルサレムで二十九年間治めました。母は、エルサレム出身のヨアダンでした。

uk.L: Двадцяти пʼяти років [був] Амація, [коли] зацарював, і двадцять девʼять років він царював у Єрусалимі, а імʼя його матері — Єгоаддан з Єрусалиму.
uk.B: Амації було двадцять пʼять років, коли він зацарював, і двадцять девʼять років він царював у Єрусалимі. Імʼя його матері — Єгоаддан; вона була з Єрусалиму.
uk.R: Амації було двадцять пʼять років, коли він став царем. Він правив у Єрусалимі двадцять девʼять років. Його матірʼю була Єгоаддан з Єрусалиму.

decisions.choice: the opening formula of 2 Kings 14:2, without the date of 14:1
decisions.reason: Chapter 25 retells the reign of Amaziah from 2 Kings 14:1-20. Kings first dates his accession by the reign of Joash king of Israel (14:1); Chronicles leaves the date out, as it usually does with the kings of the north, and names Amaziah in this verse instead of saying "he". The rest of the verse is the same as 2 Kings 14:2. There the written consonants spell the mother's name Jehoaddin and the form read aloud Jehoaddan; Chronicles has Jehoaddan. It is the same woman.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-five years: twenty-five years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years, as in 2 Kings 14:2.

decisions.choice: the name of his mother: the queen mother
decisions.reason: Kings and Chronicles name the mother of each king of Judah, who held an honored place at court.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:2
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the wording it uses at 2 Kings 14:2, with the name Amaziah where Chronicles has it. Literal adds "when" in brackets, since the Hebrew here has no word for "he was".

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 14:2; "Joadán"
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its wording of 2 Kings 14:2. The Hebrew of Chronicles spells the queen mother's name Jehoaddan, where Kings has Jehoaddin (Spanish Joadín), so Spanish writes "Joadán" here, as the English keeps each book's form.

decisions.choice: "Yehoaddân"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the queen mother's name with a in the last syllable where 2 Kings 14:2 has i; French follows each book, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 14:2-20
decisions.reason: Chapter 25 retells 2 Kings 14:1-20; where the Hebrew is the same, each level keeps its Swahili of Kings. The mother's name follows the Chronicles spelling here (Yehoadani), where Kings has Yehoadini.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:2 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 14:2 (m1), so the Vietnamese Kings wording is reused.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 14:2 with figures at every level ("25세", "29년")
decisions.reason: Chronicles reuses the Kings wording, and this block writes ages and years in figures, as the 1 Kings drafts do.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:2 in Portuguese; Amazias; Jeoadã
decisions.reason: Chapter 25 retells 2 Kings 14:1-20 (m1), and each level keeps the Portuguese of that chapter where the Hebrew is the same, changing only what Chronicles changes. Here Chronicles names "Amazias" where Kings says "ele", and has no "he was", so Literal brackets "tinha" and "quando", as the English does. The queen mother's name follows Chronicles' spelling, as the English "Jehoaddan" does, with the nasal ending Portuguese writes for a final "-an" ("Natã"), where 2 Kings 14:2 has "Jeoadim".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 14:2 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Chronicles names Amaziah in the formula ("አሜስያስ" at the head) and has no date by Joash of Israel (2 Kings 14:1).
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

decisions.choice: The formula of 2 Kings 14:2 in this translation; "यहोअद्दान"
decisions.reason: The same opening as Kings (meaning m1), with the name; Chronicles spells the queen mother Jehoaddan, kept apart from Kings' "यहोअद्दीन".

decisions.choice: "Иегоаддань", as 2 Kings 14:2
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the queen mother's name a little differently from 2 Kings 14:2; it is the same woman, so the Kings form is kept, with the Kings formula.

decisions.choice: Jehoaddan "ヨアダン", as the Hebrew of Chronicles spells the name.
decisions.reason: 2 Kings writes Jehoaddin; the Hebrew here is followed, the rest of the formula as 2 Kings 14:2.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א בְּלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, only not with a heart whole.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, only not with a whole heart.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, yet not with a whole heart.
en.R: Amaziah did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, but he did not do it with all his heart.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no con un corazón íntegro.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aunque no de todo corazón.
es.R: Amasías hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no lo hizo de todo corazón.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, seulement pas d’un cœur entier.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais pas d’un cœur entier.
fr.R: Amatsia a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, mais il ne l’a pas fait de tout son cœur.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ila si kwa moyo mkamilifu.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini si kwa moyo mkamilifu.
sw.R: Amazia alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, lakini hakuyafanya kwa moyo wake wote.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ là không với một tấm lòng trọn vẹn.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng không với một tấm lòng trọn vẹn.
vi.R: A-ma-xia làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, nhưng không hết lòng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했으나, 온전한 마음으로 하지는 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했으나, 온전한 마음으로 하지는 않았다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다. 그러나 온 마음을 다해서 하지는 않았다.

pt.L: E fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, somente não com um coração íntegro.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas não com um coração íntegro.
pt.R: Amazias fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, mas não fez isso de todo o coração.

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይንም ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም።
am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በሙሉ ልብ አልነበረም።
am.R: አሜስያስ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክል ነው የሚለውን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በሙሉ ልቡ አላደረገውም።

hi.L: और उसने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, पर पूरे मन से नहीं।
hi.B: उसने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, फिर भी पूरे मन से नहीं।
hi.R: अमस्याह ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, पर उसने यह पूरे मन से नहीं किया।

ru.L: И делал он то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, только не с цельным сердцем.
ru.B: Он делал то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, но не от всего сердца.
ru.R: Амасия делал то, что нравилось {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, но делал это не всем сердцем.

ja.L: そして彼は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいことを行った。ただ、全き心をもってではなかった。
ja.B: 彼は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいとされることを行ったが、全き心をもってではなかった。
ja.R: アマツヤは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が正しいと言われることをしました。けれども、心の底からそうしたのではありませんでした。

uk.L: І робив він правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, тільки не з цілим серцем.
uk.B: Він робив те, що було правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, проте не з цілим серцем.
uk.R: Амація робив те, що подобалося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, але робив це не всім своїм серцем.

decisions.choice: not with a whole heart: in place of the comparison with David and Joash
decisions.reason: The first half is the same as 2 Kings 14:3. Kings goes on to say that Amaziah was not like David but did as his father Joash had done, and that the high places stayed (14:3-4). Chronicles says instead that he did right "only not with a whole heart", and leaves out the high places.

decisions.choice: a whole heart: undivided loyalty
decisions.reason: A "whole" or complete heart is loyalty given fully and without holding back, the heart David asked for Solomon (1 Chronicles 28:9; 29:19) and that Asa had (2 Chronicles 15:17).

decisions.choice: a divided heart that shows itself later
decisions.reason: The note prepares for the rest of the chapter: Amaziah obeys the prophet once (verses 7-10) but then worships the gods of Edom (verse 14) and turns from Yahweh (verse 27).

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The good verdict is worded the same way at each level throughout these books, as in 2 Kings 14:3. Readable names Amaziah and says "with all his heart" for the idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: somente não com um coração íntegro (L), mas não com um coração íntegro (B), mas não ... de todo o coração (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps the words of 2 Kings 14:3 in Portuguese (r-en-1); what follows is Chronicles' own (m1). The whole heart (m2) is "íntegro" at Literal and Balanced, the word 15:17 and 16:9 use in Portuguese for Asa's heart, and "de todo o coração" at Readable.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 14:3 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; the verdict formula is kept, but Chronicles has "only not with a whole heart" ("ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም") in place of the comparison with David and Joash, and has nothing for Kings 14:4 on the high places.
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־עֲבָדָ֔יו הַמַּכִּ֖ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when was strong the kingdom upon him, and he killed his servants, the [ones] striking down the king his father.

en.L: And it happened, as soon as the kingdom was firm upon him, that he killed his servants who had struck down the king his father.
en.B: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
en.R: As soon as Amaziah had firm control of the kingdom, he put to death the officials who had killed his father, the king.

es.L: Y sucedió que, en cuanto el reino se afirmó sobre él, mató a sus siervos, los que habían herido al rey su padre.
es.B: En cuanto tuvo el reino firmemente bajo su control, ejecutó a los funcionarios que habían asesinado a su padre, el rey.
es.R: En cuanto Amasías tuvo el control firme del reino, mandó matar a los funcionarios que habían matado a su padre, el rey.

fr.L: Et il arriva, dès que la royauté fut affermie sur lui, qu’il tua ses serviteurs qui avaient frappé le roi son père.
fr.B: Dès que la royauté fut solidement entre ses mains, il fit exécuter les officiers qui avaient assassiné le roi son père.
fr.R: Dès qu’Amatsia a eu le pouvoir bien en main, il a fait mourir les officiers qui avaient tué son père, le roi.

sw.L: Ikawa, mara ufalme ulipokuwa imara juu yake, akawaua watumishi wake waliompiga mfalme baba yake.
sw.B: Mara ufalme ulipokuwa imara chini ya mamlaka yake, aliwaua maafisa wale waliomwua baba yake mfalme.
sw.R: Mara Amazia alipokwisha kuushika ufalme kwa uthabiti, aliwaua maafisa waliokuwa wamemwua baba yake, mfalme.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi vương quốc đã vững chắc trong tay vua, vua giết các đầy tớ của mình là những kẻ đã giết vua cha.
vi.B: Ngay khi vương quốc đã vững vàng trong tay, vua xử tử các triều thần đã ám sát vua cha.
vi.R: Ngay khi A-ma-xia nắm vững quyền cai trị vương quốc, vua xử tử các quan chức đã giết cha mình là vua.

ko.L: 그리고 나라가 그 위에 굳게 서자마자, 그가 왕인 그의 아버지를 쳐 죽인 그의 신하들을 죽였다.
ko.B: 나라가 그의 다스림 아래 확고해지자마자, 그는 왕인 자기 아버지를 살해한 신하들을 처형했다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 나라를 확실히 다스리게 되자마자, 왕이었던 자기 아버지를 죽인 신하들을 사형에 처했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, logo que o reino se firmou sobre ele, ele matou os seus escravos que tinham ferido o rei, seu pai.
pt.B: Assim que o reino ficou firme nas suas mãos, ele executou os oficiais que tinham assassinado o seu pai, o rei.
pt.R: Assim que Amazias teve o controle firme do reino, ele mandou matar os oficiais que tinham matado o seu pai, o rei.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ መንግሥቱ በእርሱ ላይ በጸና ጊዜ ንጉሡን አባቱን የመቱትን ባሪያዎቹን ገደለ።
am.B: መንግሥቱ በእጁ እንደ ጸና ወዲያውኑ ንጉሡን አባቱን የገደሉትን ሹማምንቱን ገደለ።
am.R: አሜስያስ መንግሥቱን አጽንቶ እንደ ያዘ ወዲያውኑ ንጉሡን አባቱን የገደሉትን ሹማምንት ገደለ።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जैसे ही राज्य उस पर दृढ़ हुआ, उसने अपने उन दासों को मार डाला जिन्होंने उसके पिता राजा को मार डाला था।
hi.B: जैसे ही राज्य उसके वश में दृढ़ हो गया, उसने उन अधिकारियों को मृत्युदंड दिया जिन्होंने उसके पिता राजा की हत्या की थी।
hi.R: जैसे ही अमस्याह का राज्य पर पूरा अधिकार हो गया, उसने उन अधिकारियों को मरवा डाला जिन्होंने उसके पिता राजा को मारा था।

ru.L: И было, как только утвердилось царство за ним, он убил своих рабов, поразивших царя, его отца.
ru.B: Как только царская власть укрепилась за ним, он казнил приближённых, которые убили его отца, царя.
ru.R: Как только Амасия крепко взял власть в свои руки, он казнил тех приближённых, которые убили его отца, царя.

ja.L: そして、王国が彼の上に強固になるやいなや、彼は、彼の父である王を打った彼の家臣たちを殺した。
ja.B: 王国が自分の手にしっかりと握られるとすぐに、彼は父である王を殺した家臣たちを処刑した。
ja.R: アマツヤは、国をしっかりと治められるようになるとすぐに、父である王を殺した家来たちを死刑にしました。

uk.L: І сталося, щойно царство утвердилося в нього, він убив своїх слуг, що вбили царя, його батька.
uk.B: Щойно царство міцно опинилося в його руках, він стратив урядовців, що вбили його батька-царя.
uk.R: Щойно Амація міцно взяв царство під свою владу, він стратив урядовців, що вбили його батька, царя.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 14:5, with two small changes
decisions.reason: Kings says the kingdom was firm "in his hand" and that he "struck down" the killers; Chronicles says the kingdom was firm "upon him" and that he "killed" them. The sense is the same: once his rule was secure, he put his father's murderers to death.

decisions.choice: the officials who had struck down the king: Zabad and Jehozabad
decisions.reason: These are the two officials who killed Joash in his bed (24:25-26).

decisions.choice: officials; executed ... murdered (Balanced); put to death ... killed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep their wording of 2 Kings 14:5. These were royal officials, so Balanced and Readable call them officials, as these books do for a king's servants at court. Balanced uses "executed" for the punishment and "murdered" for the crime.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:5 in Portuguese, with "sobre ele" and "matou" (L)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 14:5 at each level, "escravos" (L) and "oficiais" (B, R) included (r-en-1). Literal follows Chronicles' two changes (m1): the kingdom was firm "sobre ele" and he "matou" the killers; at Balanced and Readable the sense is the same, so Kings' wording stands.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 14:5 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Chronicles has "upon him" (Literal "በእርሱ ላይ") for "in his hand", and "he killed" ("ገደለ") for "he struck".
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.
As 2 Kings 14:5 in this translation, with the king's servants in the forms of the history-books note; Chronicles has "upon him" for "in his hand" (meaning m1).

source.text: וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כִּ֣י כַכָּת֣וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֡ה בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־יָמ֨וּתוּ אָב֤וֹת עַל־בָּנִים֙ וּבָנִים֙ לֹא־יָמ֣וּתוּ עַל־אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יָמֽוּתוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And their sons not he put to death, but according to [what is] written in the law, in [the] book of Moses, which commanded Yahweh, saying, Not will die fathers on account of sons, and sons not will die on account of fathers, but [each] man for his sin they will die.

en.L: But their {{gender:children|sons}} he did not put to death, but [did] according to what is written in the law, in the book of Moses, which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded, saying, "{{gender:Parents|Fathers}} shall not die for {{gender:children|sons}}, and {{gender:children|sons}} shall not die for {{gender:parents|fathers}}; but each shall die for {{gender:their|his}} own sin."
en.B: But he did not put their {{gender:children|sons}} to death. In this he followed the law as it stands written in the book of Moses, in which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave this command: "{{gender:Parents|Fathers}} are not to die for their {{gender:children|sons}}, nor {{gender:children|sons}} for their {{gender:parents|fathers}}. Each one is to die only for {{gender:their|his}} own sin."
en.R: But he did not kill their {{gender:children|sons}}. He obeyed what is written in the law, in the book of Moses. There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded, "Do not put {{gender:parents|fathers}} to death for what their {{gender:children|sons}} have done. Do not put {{gender:children|sons}} to death for what their {{gender:parents|fathers}} have done. People may be put to death only for their own sin."

es.L: Pero a los hijos de ellos no les dio muerte, sino [hizo] conforme a lo que está escrito en la ley, en el libro de Moisés, que mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diciendo: «No morirán los padres por los hijos, ni los hijos morirán por los padres; sino que cada uno morirá por su propio pecado».
es.B: Pero no dio muerte a los hijos de ellos. En esto se atuvo a lo que está escrito en la ley, en el libro de Moisés, en el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó: «No morirán los padres por sus hijos, ni los hijos por sus padres. Cada uno morirá solo por su propio pecado».
es.R: Pero no mató a los hijos de los asesinos. Obedeció lo que está escrito en la ley, en el libro de Moisés. Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó: «No mates a los padres por lo que hayan hecho sus hijos. No mates a los hijos por lo que hayan hecho sus padres. Cada uno solo puede morir por su propio pecado».

fr.L: Mais leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}, il ne les fit pas mourir, mais [il agit] selon ce qui est écrit dans la loi, dans le livre de Moïse, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prescrit en disant : « Les {{gender:parents|pères}} ne mourront pas pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}}, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ne mourront pas pour les {{gender:parents|pères}} ; mais chacun mourra pour son propre péché. »
fr.B: Mais il ne fit pas mourir leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}. Il s’en tint en cela à la loi, telle qu’elle est écrite dans le livre de Moïse, où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prescrit : « Les {{gender:parents|pères}} ne mourront pas pour leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}, ni les {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour leurs {{gender:parents|pères}}. Chacun mourra seulement pour son propre péché. »
fr.R: Mais il n’a pas fait mourir leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}. Il a obéi à ce qui est écrit dans la loi, dans le livre de Moïse. Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné cet ordre : « Ne faites pas mourir les {{gender:parents|pères}} pour ce que leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} ont fait. Ne faites pas mourir les {{gender:enfants|fils}} pour ce que leurs {{gender:parents|pères}} ont fait. On ne peut faire mourir quelqu’un que pour son propre péché. »

sw.L: Lakini wana wao hakuwaua, bali [alifanya] sawasawa na ilivyoandikwa katika sheria, katika kitabu cha Musa, ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, akisema, "Baba hawatakufa kwa ajili ya wana, wala wana hawatakufa kwa ajili ya baba; bali kila mtu atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe."
sw.B: Lakini hakuwaua watoto wao. Katika hilo alishika sheria kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Musa, ambamo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, "Wazazi wasife kwa ajili ya watoto wao, wala watoto wasife kwa ajili ya wazazi wao. Kila mtu atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe tu."
sw.R: Lakini hakuwaua watoto wao. Alitii yale yaliyoandikwa katika sheria, katika kitabu cha Musa. Humo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru, "Msiwaue wazazi kwa sababu ya yale waliyofanya watoto wao. Msiwaue watoto kwa sababu ya yale waliyofanya wazazi wao. Mtu anaweza kuuawa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe tu."

vi.L: Nhưng con cái của họ thì vua không xử tử, mà [làm] theo điều đã chép trong luật pháp, trong sách Môi-se, mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền rằng: "{{gender:Cha mẹ|Cha}} sẽ không chết vì {{gender:con cái|con}}, và {{gender:con cái|con}} sẽ không chết vì {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}; nhưng mỗi người sẽ chết vì tội của chính mình."
vi.B: Nhưng vua không xử tử con cái của họ. Như vậy vua làm theo luật pháp đã chép trong sách Môi-se, trong đó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền: "{{gender:Cha mẹ|Cha}} không phải chết vì {{gender:con cái|con}}, {{gender:con cái|con}} cũng không phải chết vì {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}. Mỗi người chỉ chết vì tội của chính mình."
vi.R: Nhưng vua không giết con cái của họ. Vua vâng theo điều đã chép trong luật pháp, trong sách Môi-se. Ở đó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền: "Đừng xử tử {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} vì điều {{gender:con cái|con}} đã làm. Đừng xử tử {{gender:con cái|con}} vì điều {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} đã làm. Mỗi người chỉ bị xử tử vì tội của chính mình."

ko.L: 그러나 그는 그들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않고, 율법에, 곧 모세의 책에 기록된 대로 [행했다]. 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하셨다. "{{gender:부모|아버지}}들은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 때문에 죽지 않을 것이고, {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들 때문에 죽지 않을 것이다. 오직 각 사람은 자기 죄 때문에 죽을 것이다."
ko.B: 그러나 그는 그들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않았다. 이 일에서 그는 율법, 곧 모세의 책에 기록된 대로 따랐는데, 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 명령하셨다. "{{gender:부모|아버지}}들이 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 때문에 죽어서는 안 되고, {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들 때문에 죽어서도 안 된다. 사람은 각자 자기 죄 때문에만 죽어야 한다."
ko.R: 그러나 그는 그들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들은 죽이지 않았다. 그는 율법, 곧 모세의 책에 기록된 말씀을 따랐다. 거기에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 명령하셨다. "{{gender:자녀|아들}}들이 한 일 때문에 {{gender:부모|아버지}}들을 죽이지 마라. {{gender:부모|아버지}}들이 한 일 때문에 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들을 죽이지 마라. 사람은 자기가 지은 죄 때문에만 죽임을 당해야 한다."

pt.L: E os filhos deles ele não matou, mas [fez] conforme o que está escrito na Lei, no livro de Moisés, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou, dizendo: "Os pais não morrerão pelos filhos, e os filhos não morrerão pelos pais; mas cada um morrerá pelo seu próprio pecado."
pt.B: Mas ele não matou os filhos deles. Nisso seguiu a Lei, como está escrita no livro de Moisés, no qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou: "Os pais não morrerão por causa dos filhos, nem os filhos por causa dos pais. Cada um morrerá somente pelo seu próprio pecado."
pt.R: Mas ele não matou os filhos deles. Ele obedeceu ao que está escrito na Lei, no livro de Moisés. Ali {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ordenou: "Não condenes à morte os pais pelo que os filhos fizeram. Não condenes à morte os filhos pelo que os pais fizeram. Uma pessoa só pode ser condenada à morte pelo seu próprio pecado."

am.L: ልጆቻቸውን ግን አልገደለም፤ ነገር ግን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ብሎ ባዘዘበት በሕጉ፣ በሙሴ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው [አደረገ]፦ «{{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}} ስለ ልጆች አይሙቱ፤ ልጆችም ስለ {{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}} አይሙቱ፤ ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ ሰው ስለ ገዛ ኃጢአቱ ይሙት።»
am.B: ነገር ግን ልጆቻቸውን አልገደለም። በዚህም በሕጉ፣ በሙሴ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ጠበቀ፤ በዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ፦ «{{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}} ስለ ልጆቻቸው አይሙቱ፤ ልጆችም ስለ {{gender:ወላጆቻቸው|አባቶቻቸው}} አይሙቱ። እያንዳንዱ የሚሞተው ስለ ገዛ ኃጢአቱ ብቻ ነው።»
am.R: ነገር ግን ልጆቻቸውን አልገደለም። በሕጉ፣ በሙሴ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ታዘዘ። በዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ፦ «ልጆቻቸው በሠሩት ነገር ምክንያት {{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}} አይገደሉ። ልጆችም {{gender:ወላጆቻቸው|አባቶቻቸው}} በሠሩት ነገር ምክንያት አይገደሉ። ሰው ሊገደል የሚችለው ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት ብቻ ነው።»

hi.L: पर उनकी {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} को उसने नहीं मार डाला, बल्कि उसके अनुसार [किया] जो व्यवस्था में, मूसा की पुस्तक में, लिखा है, जिसमें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह आज्ञा दी थी, "{{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} के कारण {{gender:माता-पिता|पिता}} न मरें, और {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} के कारण {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} न मरें; पर हर एक अपने ही पाप के लिए मरे।"
hi.B: पर उसने उनकी {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} को मृत्युदंड नहीं दिया। इसमें उसने व्यवस्था का पालन किया, जैसा मूसा की पुस्तक में लिखा है, जिसमें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आज्ञा दी थी, "{{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} के कारण {{gender:माता-पिता|पिता}} न मरें, और न {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} के कारण {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}}। हर एक केवल अपने ही पाप के लिए मरे।"
hi.R: पर उसने उनके {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} को नहीं मारा। उसने वही माना जो व्यवस्था में, मूसा की पुस्तक में, लिखा है। वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आज्ञा दी थी, "{{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} के कामों के लिए {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} को मृत्युदंड मत देना। {{gender:माता-पिता|पिताओं}} के कामों के लिए {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} को मृत्युदंड मत देना। लोगों को केवल उनके अपने पाप के लिए मृत्युदंड दिया जा सकता है।"

ru.L: Но {{gender:детей|сыновей}} их он не умертвил, а [поступил] по написанному в законе, в книге Моисея, где {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} повелел, говоря: «Пусть не умирают {{gender:родители|отцы}} за {{gender:детей|сыновей}}, и {{gender:дети|сыновья}} пусть не умирают за {{gender:родителей|отцов}}; но каждый за свой грех пусть умрёт.»
ru.B: Но {{gender:детей|сыновей}} их он не казнил. В этом он поступил по закону, как написано в книге Моисея, где {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} повелел: «{{gender:Родители|Отцы}} не должны умирать за {{gender:детей|сыновей}}, а {{gender:дети|сыновья}} — за {{gender:родителей|отцов}}. Каждый должен умереть только за свой собственный грех.»
ru.R: Но {{gender:детей|сыновей}} их он не казнил. Он послушался того, что написано в законе, в книге Моисея. Там {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} повелел: «Не казните {{gender:родителей|отцов}} за то, что сделали их {{gender:дети|сыновья}}. Не казните {{gender:детей|сыновей}} за то, что сделали их {{gender:родители|отцы}}. Человека можно казнить только за его собственный грех.»

ja.L: しかし、彼は彼らの子らを殺さなかった。律法に、モーセの書に記されているとおりである。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう命じて言われた。「{{gender:親|父}}たちは子らのために死んではならず、子らは{{gender:親|父}}たちのために死んではならない。人はそれぞれ、自分の罪のために死ななければならない。」
ja.B: しかし、彼は彼らの子どもたちは殺さなかった。モーセの書の律法に記されているとおりに従ったのである。その中で{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう命じられた。「{{gender:親|父}}は子のために死ぬことはなく、子は{{gender:親|父}}のために死ぬことはない。人はそれぞれ、自分自身の罪のためにだけ死ぬのである。」
ja.R: しかし、その者たちの子どもは、殺しませんでした。モーセの書の律法に書かれていることに従ったのです。そこで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、こう命じておられます。「子どもがしたことのために、{{gender:親|父親}}を死刑にしてはいけない。{{gender:親|父親}}がしたことのために、子どもを死刑にしてはいけない。人は自分の罪のためにだけ、死刑にされるのだ。」

uk.L: Але їхніх {{gender:дітей|синів}} він не вбив, а [вчинив] за тим, що написано в законі, у книзі Мойсея, як наказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, кажучи: «Не помруть батьки за {{gender:дітей|синів}}, і {{gender:діти|сини}} не помруть за батьків; але кожен помре за свій гріх.»
uk.B: Але їхніх {{gender:дітей|синів}} він не вбив. У цьому він дотримався закону, як написано в книзі Мойсея, де {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав такий наказ: «Батьки не повинні вмирати за своїх {{gender:дітей|синів}}, ані {{gender:діти|сини}} за своїх батьків. Кожен має вмерти лише за свій гріх.»
uk.R: Але він не вбив їхніх {{gender:дітей|синів}}. Він послухався того, що написано в законі, у книзі Мойсея. Там {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} наказав: «Не карайте смертю батьків за те, що зробили їхні {{gender:діти|сини}}. Не карайте смертю {{gender:дітей|синів}} за те, що зробили їхні батьки. Людину можна покарати смертю лише за її власний гріх.»

decisions.choice: a quotation of Deuteronomy 24:16, as in 2 Kings 14:6
decisions.reason: The law quoted is Deuteronomy 24:16. Deuteronomy and Kings say "shall be put to death"; Chronicles uses the plain verb "shall die" all three times. In a law about punishment it means the same thing: no one is to be executed for another's crime. Like Kings, Chronicles adds "but" before the last clause; like Deuteronomy, it keeps the last verb plural ("they shall die").

decisions.choice: in the law, in the book of Moses
decisions.reason: Kings says "in the book of the law of Moses" (2 Kings 14:6); Chronicles says "in the law, in the book of Moses". Both name the written law Moses gave (Deuteronomy 31:9, 24-26).

decisions.choice: sons ... fathers: children and parents
decisions.reason: In the law the words cover parents and children of either sex, as in Deuteronomy 24:16. "Their sons" are the killers' children, named with the same word the law uses.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 14:6; "die" at Literal and Balanced; Parents / children; their
decisions.reason: Each level follows its wording of 2 Kings 14:6 and Deuteronomy 24:16. Literal and Balanced say "die" where Chronicles has the plain verb (m1); Readable keeps "put to death", which is what the verb means here. The gender setting gives "parents", "children" and "their" by default and "fathers", "sons" and "his" as the alternative (m3). Literal supplies "did" after the second "but".

decisions.choice: "los padres ... los hijos", no gender setting
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its wording of Spanish 2 Kings 14:6, with "morirán" at Balanced as Chronicles has "die". Spanish "padres" and "hijos" already include mothers and daughters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart here.

decisions.choice: "parents" / "pères"; "enfants" / "fils"; no span on "son propre péché"
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 14:6: the inclusive default with the Hebrew's fathers and sons as the alternative; "chacun ... son" is already generic in French, so it takes no span where the English has one. Literal and Balanced say "mourront" where Chronicles has the plain verb.

decisions.choice: no gender span; baba / wana (L), wazazi / watoto (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili of 2 Kings 14:6, Balanced and Readable say "wazazi" and "watoto", which already include men and women, so Swahili has no gender span here; Literal keeps "baba" and "wana". Chronicles has "die" where Kings has "be put to death", and Literal and Balanced say "kufa".

decisions.choice: gender spans "cha mẹ
decisions.reason: con", as 2 Kings 14:6

decisions.choice: The gender spans of the 2 Kings 14:6 draft, 자녀 / 아들 and 부모 / 아버지; "죽다" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Korean has two real wordings here, as in Kings; Literal and Balanced say "die" where Chronicles has the plain verb (m1), and Readable keeps "죽임을 당하다".

decisions.choice: os pais / os filhos with no gender setting; morrerão (L, B); "Não condenes" (R); na Lei, no livro de Moisés
decisions.reason: The law keeps the words of 2 Kings 14:6 and Deuteronomy 24:16 in Portuguese at each level, with "morrerão" at Literal and Balanced for Chronicles' plain verb "die" (m1) and Readable's commandment in God's "tu", as in Kings. Portuguese "pais" already means parents and "filhos" children of either sex (m3), so the English gender setting has no second wording here, as in 2 Kings 14:6. "Na Lei, no livro de Moisés" follows Chronicles' order (m2), with the capital 23:18 gives the Law of Moses.

decisions.choice: "ልጆች" carries no gender span; "fathers" keeps {{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}}, as in 2 Kings 14:6.
alternatives: spans on every word the English marks
decisions.reason: Amharic "ልጆች" already means sons and daughters, and the generic "each" ("እያንዳንዱ") is inclusive, so only "fathers" has a second wording for the setting to offer.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 14:6 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Chronicles has "their sons" ("ልጆቻቸውን") for "the sons of the slayers", "in the law, in the book of Moses" ("በሕጉ፣ በሙሴ መጽሐፍ") for "in the book of the law of Moses", and in the quotation "shall die" ("አይሙቱ", "ይሙት") where Kings and Deuteronomy 24:16 have "be put to death" ("አይገደሉ"); Readable, which says the sense, keeps the Kings wording.
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

decisions.choice: The gender spans and wording of 2 Kings 14:6 in this translation, with "मरें" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The same quotation of Deuteronomy 24:16 (meaning m1); Chronicles has "shall not die" where Kings has "shall not be put to death", so Literal and Balanced say "मरें" as the English says "die".

decisions.choice: "умирают ... умрёт" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "die" where 2 Kings 14:6 has "be put to death", so Literal and Balanced say "умирать"; Readable keeps the Kings wording, as the English Readable does. The gender spans are those of 2 Kings 14:6; "каждый" and "свой" need none.

decisions.choice: Deuteronomy 24:16 worded as in 2 Kings 14:6 and Deuteronomy, with "死ぬ" at L and B where Chronicles says "die"; only "{{gender:親|父}}" takes a span, "子" and "自分" are already inclusive.
alternatives: spans on 子ら and on the pronoun as in the English
decisions.reason: As DEU-consistency: the gender span only where the English spans parents|fathers.

source.text: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֣ם לְבֵית־אָב֗וֹת לְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וּלְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת לְכָל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֗ם לְמִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיִּמְצָאֵ֗ם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף בָּחוּר֙ יוֹצֵ֣א צָבָ֔א אֹחֵ֖ז רֹ֥מַח וְצִנָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered Amaziah Judah and set them by house of fathers, by commanders of the thousands and by commanders of the hundreds, for all Judah and Benjamin; and he mustered them from [a] son of twenty year[s] and upward, and he found them three hundred thousand chosen, going out [to the] army, holding spear and large shield.

en.L: And Amaziah gathered Judah and set them by fathers' houses, under commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, for all Judah and Benjamin. And he mustered them from twenty years old and upward, and found them [to be] 300,000 chosen [men], going out [to the] army, handling spear and large shield.
en.B: Amaziah assembled the men of Judah and organized them by their ancestral families under commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, for all Judah and Benjamin. He mustered those twenty years old and over and found 300,000 chosen men fit for war, able to handle spear and large shield.
en.R: Amaziah called together the men of Judah. He arranged them by families and put commanders over units of a thousand and units of a hundred. He did this for all Judah and Benjamin. Then he counted the men who were twenty years old or older. There were 300,000 of the best soldiers, ready for war and able to fight with spear and large shield.

es.L: Y Amasías reunió a Judá y los puso por casas paternas, bajo jefes de mil y jefes de cien, por todo Judá y Benjamín; y los contó de veinte años arriba, y halló que eran 300 000 escogidos, que salían a la guerra y manejaban lanza y escudo.
es.B: Amasías reunió a los hombres de Judá y los organizó por familias, bajo jefes de mil y jefes de cien, en todo Judá y Benjamín. Hizo el censo de los de veinte años para arriba y halló 300 000 hombres escogidos, aptos para la guerra, que sabían manejar la lanza y el escudo grande.
es.R: Amasías reunió a los hombres de Judá. Los organizó por familias y puso jefes sobre grupos de mil y de cien. Lo hizo en todo Judá y Benjamín. Luego contó a los hombres de veinte años para arriba. Había 300 000 de los mejores soldados, listos para la guerra y capaces de pelear con lanza y escudo grande.

fr.L: Et Amatsia rassembla Juda et les plaça par maisons des pères, sous des chefs de milliers et des chefs de centaines, pour tout Juda et Benjamin ; et il les recensa depuis l’âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, et il les trouva [au nombre de] 300 000 [hommes] d’élite, aptes à sortir à l’armée, maniant la lance et le grand bouclier.
fr.B: Amatsia rassembla les hommes de Juda et les organisa par familles, sous des chefs de milliers et des chefs de centaines, pour tout Juda et Benjamin. Il recensa ceux de vingt ans et plus, et il trouva 300 000 hommes d’élite, aptes à la guerre, capables de manier la lance et le grand bouclier.
fr.R: Amatsia a réuni les hommes de Juda. Il les a répartis par familles et il a mis des chefs à la tête de groupes de mille et de groupes de cent. Il a fait cela pour tout Juda et Benjamin. Ensuite il a compté les hommes de vingt ans et plus. Il y avait 300 000 très bons soldats, prêts pour la guerre et capables de combattre avec la lance et le grand bouclier.

sw.L: Amazia akawakusanya Yuda, akawapanga kwa nyumba za baba, chini ya wakuu wa maelfu na wakuu wa mamia, kwa ajili ya Yuda wote na Benyamini. Akawahesabu tangu mwana wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, akawaona [kuwa] 300,000 [watu] wateule, wanaotoka [kwenda] jeshini, wanaoshika mkuki na ngao kubwa.
sw.B: Amazia aliwakusanya watu wa Yuda, akawapanga kwa jamaa zao za mababu chini ya wakuu wa maelfu na wakuu wa mamia, kwa ajili ya Yuda wote na Benyamini. Akawahesabu wale wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, akapata watu wateule 300,000 wanaofaa kwa vita, wenye uwezo wa kutumia mkuki na ngao kubwa.
sw.R: Amazia aliwaita pamoja wanaume wa Yuda. Akawapanga kwa jamaa zao, akaweka makamanda juu ya vikosi vya watu elfu moja na vikosi vya watu mia moja. Alifanya hivyo kwa Yuda wote na Benyamini. Kisha akawahesabu wanaume wenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi. Walikuwa askari bora 300,000, tayari kwa vita na wenye uwezo wa kupigana kwa mkuki na ngao kubwa.

vi.L: A-ma-xia nhóm Giu-đa lại và sắp đặt họ theo gia tộc, dưới quyền các chỉ huy nghìn người và các chỉ huy trăm người, cho cả Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min. Vua kiểm tra quân số từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên, và thấy có ba trăm nghìn [người] được tuyển chọn, ra trận được, sử dụng được giáo và khiên lớn.
vi.B: A-ma-xia triệu tập người Giu-đa và tổ chức họ theo gia tộc, dưới quyền các chỉ huy nghìn người và các chỉ huy trăm người, cho cả Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min. Vua kiểm tra những người từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên và thấy có 300.000 người tinh nhuệ, có thể ra trận, biết sử dụng giáo và khiên lớn.
vi.R: A-ma-xia gọi những người đàn ông Giu-đa lại. Vua sắp xếp họ theo gia đình và đặt các chỉ huy trên những đơn vị một nghìn người và một trăm người. Vua làm như vậy cho cả Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min. Rồi vua đếm những người từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên. Có 300.000 binh sĩ giỏi nhất, sẵn sàng ra trận và biết đánh bằng giáo và khiên lớn.

ko.L: 그리고 아마샤가 유다를 모으고, 온 유다와 베냐민을 조상의 집별로, 천부장들과 백부장들 아래 세웠다. 그리고 그가 20세 이상인 자들을 계수하여, 군대에 나갈 수 있고 창과 큰 방패를 다룰 수 있는 정예 300,000명을 찾아냈다.
ko.B: 아마샤는 유다 사람들을 불러 모으고, 온 유다와 베냐민을 가문별로 나누어 천부장들과 백부장들 아래 두었다. 그리고 20세 이상 된 남자들을 계수하니, 전쟁에 나가 창과 큰 방패를 다룰 수 있는 정예 군사가 300,000명이었다.
ko.R: 아마샤는 유다 사람들을 불러 모았다. 그는 그들을 집안별로 나누고, 천 명씩과 백 명씩을 맡을 지휘관들을 세웠다. 그는 온 유다와 베냐민에서 이렇게 했다. 그리고 20세 이상 된 남자들을 세어 보니, 창과 큰 방패를 들고 싸울 수 있는 가장 뛰어난 군사가 300,000명이었다.

pt.L: E Amazias reuniu Judá e os pôs segundo as famílias, sob chefes de milhares e chefes de centenas, por todo o Judá e Benjamim. E os contou de vinte anos para cima, e achou que eram trezentos mil escolhidos, que saíam ao exército, que manejavam lança e escudo grande.
pt.B: Amazias reuniu os homens de Judá e os organizou segundo as suas famílias, sob comandantes de milhares e comandantes de centenas, para todo o Judá e Benjamim. Ele contou os que tinham vinte anos ou mais e encontrou trezentos mil homens escolhidos, aptos para a guerra, capazes de manejar lança e escudo grande.
pt.R: Amazias reuniu os homens de Judá. Ele os organizou por famílias e pôs comandantes sobre grupos de mil e grupos de cem soldados. Fez isso em todo o Judá e Benjamim. Depois contou os homens de vinte anos ou mais. Eram trezentos mil dos melhores soldados, prontos para a guerra e capazes de lutar com lança e escudo grande.

am.L: አሜስያስም ይሁዳን ሰበሰበ፤ ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ሁሉ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፣ በሺህ አለቆችና በመቶ አለቆች ሥር አቆማቸው። ከሃያ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ ያሉትንም ቆጠራቸው፤ ወደ ሠራዊት የሚወጡ፣ ጦርና ትልቅ ጋሻ የሚይዙ 300,000 የተመረጡ [ሰዎችም] ሆነው አገኛቸው።
am.B: አሜስያስ የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሰበሰበ፤ ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ሁሉ በየቤተሰባቸው በሺህ አለቆችና በመቶ አለቆች ሥር አደራጃቸው። ዕድሜያቸው ሃያ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑትን ቆጠረ፤ ለጦርነት ብቁ የሆኑ፣ ጦርና ትልቅ ጋሻ መያዝ የሚችሉ 300,000 የተመረጡ ሰዎችንም አገኘ።
am.R: አሜስያስ የይሁዳን ሰዎች በአንድነት ጠራ። በየቤተሰባቸው አደራጃቸው፤ በሺህና በመቶ ሰዎች ላይም አለቆችን ሾመ። ይህንም ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ሁሉ አደረገ። ከዚያም ዕድሜያቸው ሃያ ዓመትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑትን ወንዶች ቆጠረ። ለጦርነት የተዘጋጁ፣ በጦርና በትልቅ ጋሻ መዋጋት የሚችሉ 300,000 ምርጥ ወታደሮች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और अमस्याह ने यहूदा को इकट्ठा किया, और सारे यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के लिए उन्हें पितरों के घरानों के अनुसार हज़ारों के प्रधानों और सैकड़ों के प्रधानों के अधीन खड़ा किया। और उसने बीस वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के लोगों की गिनती की, और उन्हें 3,00,000 चुने हुए [पुरुष] पाया, जो सेना में जाने योग्य, भाला और बड़ी ढाल चलानेवाले थे।
hi.B: अमस्याह ने यहूदा के पुरुषों को इकट्ठा किया, और सारे यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के लिए उन्हें पितृकुलों के अनुसार हज़ारों के प्रधानों और सैकड़ों के प्रधानों के अधीन ठहराया। उसने बीस वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के लोगों की गिनती की और 3,00,000 चुने हुए पुरुष पाए, जो युद्ध के योग्य थे और भाला और बड़ी ढाल चला सकते थे।
hi.R: अमस्याह ने यहूदा के पुरुषों को इकट्ठा किया। उसने उन्हें परिवारों के अनुसार बाँटा और हज़ार-हज़ार और सौ-सौ सैनिकों की टुकड़ियों पर प्रधान ठहराए। उसने यह सारे यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के लिए किया। फिर उसने उन पुरुषों की गिनती की जो बीस वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के थे। वे 3,00,000 सबसे अच्छे सैनिक थे, जो युद्ध के लिए तैयार थे और भाले और बड़ी ढाल से लड़ सकते थे।

ru.L: И собрал Амасия Иуду, и поставил их по отцовским домам, под тысяченачальниками и сотниками, по всему Иуде и Вениамину; и пересчитал их от двадцати лет и выше, и нашёл их триста тысяч отборных, выходящих на войну, владеющих копьём и большим щитом.
ru.B: Амасия собрал мужчин Иуды и распределил их по семьям под началом тысяченачальников и сотников, по всему Иуде и Вениамину. Он пересчитал тех, кому было двадцать лет и больше, и нашёл 300 000 отборных воинов, годных для войны, умеющих владеть копьём и большим щитом.
ru.R: Амасия собрал мужчин Иуды. Он разделил их по семьям и поставил над ними начальников над тысячами и над сотнями. Так он сделал по всему Иуде и Вениамину. Потом он пересчитал мужчин от двадцати лет и старше. Оказалось 300 000 лучших воинов, готовых к войне и умеющих сражаться копьём и большим щитом.

ja.L: そしてアマツヤはユダを集め、ユダとベニヤミンのすべてについて、父祖の家ごとに、千人隊の長たちと百人隊の長たちの下に立てた。そして二十歳以上の者を数え、彼らが、軍に出て行き、槍と大盾を扱う、選り抜きの者三十万であるのを見いだした。
ja.B: アマツヤはユダの人々を呼び集め、ユダとベニヤミンの全体を一族ごとに組織して、千人隊の長と百人隊の長の下に置いた。二十歳以上の者を数えると、戦いに出ることができ、槍と大盾を扱える選り抜きの者が三十万人いた。
ja.R: アマツヤは、ユダの男たちを呼び集めました。そして、家族ごとに分けて、千人や百人の兵士を率いる隊長たちを、その上に立てました。ユダとベニヤミンの全体で、そうしました。それから、二十歳以上の男たちを数えました。戦いに出られて、槍と大きな盾を使って戦える、えりすぐりの兵士が、三十万人いました。

uk.L: І зібрав Амація Юду, і поставив їх за батьківськими домами, під тисяцькими і сотниками, для всього Юди і Веніямина. І перелічив він їх від двадцяти років і вище, і знайшов їх триста тисяч вибраних, що виходили [до] війська, що володіли списом і великим щитом.
uk.B: Амація зібрав чоловіків Юди і впорядкував їх за родами під тисяцькими і сотниками, для всього Юди і Веніямина. Він перелічив тих, кому було двадцять років і більше, і знайшов триста тисяч добірних чоловіків, придатних до війни, що вміли володіти списом і великим щитом.
uk.R: Амація скликав чоловіків Юди. Він упорядкував їх за родами і поставив начальників над загонами по тисячі і по сотні. Він зробив це для всього Юди і Веніямина. Потім він перелічив чоловіків, яким було двадцять років і більше. Було триста тисяч найкращих воїнів, готових до війни і здатних битися списом і великим щитом.

decisions.choice: by fathers' houses, under commanders of thousands and of hundreds
decisions.reason: The army was raised and led through the family structure of the tribes, each ancestral family supplying men under officers over units of a thousand and of a hundred, as in Numbers 1:2 and 31:14. This muster is not in Kings.

decisions.choice: mustered from twenty years old: counted for military service
decisions.reason: The verb means to count and enroll men for the army. Twenty was the age for service in the census of Numbers 1:3. On the size of numbers given in thousands, see the note at Numbers 1:21; here, as there, the text is read as giving the number.

decisions.choice: spear and large shield: heavy infantry
decisions.reason: The large shield covered the whole body and was carried with a spear by soldiers who fought in close ranks, as in 14:7.

decisions.choice: chosen, going out to the army: picked men fit for war
decisions.reason: "Chosen" names men picked for their fitness (13:3). "Going out to the army" means able to go to war, as in Numbers 1:3.

decisions.choice: ancestral families (Balanced), families (Readable); men; the best soldiers
decisions.reason: "Fathers' houses" is "ancestral families" at Balanced and "families" at Readable, as in the earlier books. Balanced and Readable add "men" to the muster, and Readable says "the best soldiers" for the chosen men.

decisions.choice: "casas paternas" (L); "familias" (B, R); "escudo grande" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ancestral houses, one wording per level as the English has; Balanced and Readable name the large shield of heavy infantry (m3).

decisions.choice: large numbers in figures with a dot at Balanced and Readable ("300.000"), in words at Literal
decisions.reason: As the 1 Kings drafts; Vietnamese writes thousands with a dot. Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: Large numbers in figures ("300,000명")
decisions.reason: Counts of an army are written in figures, as the English writes them and as the style guide sets for large numbers.

decisions.choice: as famílias; chefes (L), comandantes (B, R) de milhares e de centenas; trezentos mil; escudo grande
decisions.reason: "Famílias" for the fathers' houses at every level, as 1:2 sets them (m1); the officers as 23:1 and 2 Kings 11:4 have them in Portuguese. The round number is written in words, as in the earlier books, where the English gives figures, and the large shield (m3) is "escudo grande", as 14:7 has it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: sarei ha'alafim / hammeot "千人隊の長", "百人隊の長" (L, B), "千人や百人の兵士を率いる隊長" (R); tsinnah "大盾" (R "大きな盾").
decisions.reason: As 1SA-consistency and 1KI 10:16.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֣ר מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֥אָה אֶ֛לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל בְּמֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־כָּֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty [men] of valor for one hundred talent[s] of silver.

en.L: And he hired from Israel 100,000 mighty [men] of valor for 100 talents of silver.
en.B: He also hired 100,000 mighty warriors from Israel for {{units:about 7,500 pounds of silver|100 talents of silver}}.
en.R: He also paid {{units:about 7,500 pounds of silver|100 talents of silver}} to hire 100,000 brave warriors from Israel.

es.L: Y contrató de Israel 100 000 valientes guerreros por cien talentos de plata.
es.B: También contrató en Israel a 100 000 guerreros valientes por {{units:unos 3 400 kilos de plata|cien talentos de plata}}.
es.R: También pagó {{units:unos 3 400 kilos de plata|cien talentos de plata}} para contratar a 100 000 guerreros valientes de Israel.

fr.L: Et il engagea d’Israël 100 000 vaillants guerriers pour cent talents d’argent.
fr.B: Il engagea aussi en Israël 100 000 vaillants guerriers pour {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes d’argent|cent talents d’argent}}.
fr.R: Il a aussi payé {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes d’argent|cent talents d’argent}} pour engager 100 000 guerriers courageux venus d’Israël.

sw.L: Akaajiri kutoka Israeli mashujaa hodari 100,000 kwa talanta 100 za fedha.
sw.B: Pia aliajiri mashujaa hodari 100,000 kutoka Israeli kwa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400 za fedha|talanta 100 za fedha}}.
sw.R: Pia alilipa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400 za fedha|talanta 100 za fedha}} ili kuajiri askari hodari 100,000 kutoka Israeli.

vi.L: Vua cũng thuê từ Y-sơ-ra-ên một trăm nghìn dũng sĩ với giá một trăm ta-lâng bạc.
vi.B: Vua cũng thuê 100.000 dũng sĩ từ Y-sơ-ra-ên với giá {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg bạc|một trăm ta-lâng bạc}}.
vi.R: Vua cũng trả {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg bạc|một trăm ta-lâng bạc}} để thuê 100.000 chiến binh dũng cảm từ Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 이스라엘에서 용맹한 용사 100,000명을 은 100달란트로 고용했다.
ko.B: 그는 또 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에 이르는 은을 주고 이스라엘에서 용맹한 용사 100,000명을 고용했다.
ko.R: 그는 또 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에 이르는 은을 주고 이스라엘에서 용감한 군인 100,000명을 사 왔다.

pt.L: E contratou de Israel cem mil valentes de guerra por cem talentos de prata.
pt.B: Ele também contratou de Israel cem mil guerreiros valentes por {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos de prata|cem talentos de prata}}.
pt.R: Ele também pagou {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos de prata|cem talentos de prata}} para contratar cem mil guerreiros corajosos de Israel.

am.L: ከእስራኤልም 100,000 ኃያላን ጀግኖችን በመቶ መክሊት ብር ቀጠረ።
am.B: ደግሞም ከእስራኤል 100,000 ኃያላን ጀግኖችን {{units:በ3,400 ኪሎ ያህል ብር|በመቶ መክሊት ብር}} ቀጠረ።
am.R: ደግሞም ከእስራኤል 100,000 ጀግኖች ወታደሮችን ለመቅጠር {{units:3,400 ኪሎ ያህል ብር|መቶ መክሊት ብር}} ከፈለ።

hi.L: और उसने इस्राएल में से 1,00,000 पराक्रमी वीर योद्धा 100 तालन्त चाँदी देकर मज़दूरी पर रखे।
hi.B: उसने {{units:लगभग 3,400 किलो चाँदी|100 तालन्त चाँदी}} देकर इस्राएल में से 1,00,000 वीर योद्धा भी मज़दूरी पर रखे।
hi.R: उसने इस्राएल में से 1,00,000 बहादुर योद्धाओं को मज़दूरी पर रखने के लिए {{units:लगभग 3,400 किलो चाँदी|100 तालन्त चाँदी}} भी दी।

ru.L: И нанял он из Израиля сто тысяч воинов-богатырей за сто талантов серебра.
ru.B: Он нанял также из Израиля 100 000 воинов-богатырей за {{units:около 3,4 тонны серебра|сто талантов серебра}}.
ru.R: Он заплатил {{units:около 3,4 тонны серебра|сто талантов серебра}}, чтобы нанять из Израиля 100 000 храбрых воинов.

ja.L: そして彼は、銀百キカルで、イスラエルから十万の力ある勇士を雇った。
ja.B: 彼はまた、銀{{units:約3.4トン|百キカル}}で、イスラエルから十万人の力ある勇士を雇った。
ja.R: アマツヤは、さらに、銀{{units:約3.4トン|百キカル}}を払って、イスラエルから十万人の勇敢な戦士を雇いました。

uk.L: І найняв він з Ізраїля сто тисяч хоробрих вояків за сто талантів срібла.
uk.B: Він також найняв з Ізраїля сто тисяч могутніх воїнів за {{units:близько 3,4 тонни срібла|сто талантів срібла}}.
uk.R: Він також заплатив {{units:близько 3,4 тонни срібла|сто талантів срібла}}, щоб найняти сто тисяч хоробрих воїнів з Ізраїлю.

decisions.choice: Israel: the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Here "Israel" is the kingdom of the north, ruled from Samaria, as the man of God makes clear in verse 7 by calling them "the sons of Ephraim".

decisions.choice: hired for 100 talents: paid soldiers
decisions.reason: Amaziah paid the king of Israel or the soldiers themselves to fight for him. A talent was a large weight of metal, about 75 pounds, so the price was very great.

decisions.choice: mighty men of valor: tried fighting men
decisions.reason: The phrase names strong, capable warriors, as in 13:3 and 14:7.

decisions.choice: about 7,500 pounds of silver / 100 talents of silver
decisions.reason: The units setting gives the weight in pounds by default and in talents as the alternative; a talent is about 75 pounds. Literal keeps "100 talents".

decisions.choice: "unos 3 400 kilos de plata" / "cien talentos de plata"
decisions.reason: The units setting gives the weight in kilos by default (a talent is about 34 kg) and in talents as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "environ 3,4 tonnes d'argent" / "cent talents d'argent"
decisions.reason: French gives metric weights by default (a talent about 34 kg, as the terms note sets), with the original unit as the alternative; the English default is in pounds.

decisions.choice: karibu kilo 3,400 za fedha / talanta 100 za fedha
decisions.reason: Swahili gives the metric weight by default (talent 34 kg), with the talents as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: units span: "khoảng 3.400 kg bạc" by default, "một trăm ta-lâng bạc" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Vietnamese gives metric by default, the talent at 34 kg as the terms note sets; Literal keeps "ta-lâng", as the Kings drafts do.

decisions.choice: A units span "약 3.4톤" / "100달란트", followed by "에 이르는 은"
decisions.reason: A talent is about 34 kg (terms note), so a hundred talents is given in tonnes, the unit a Korean reader uses for such a weight; "에" fits after both wordings, where 을/를 would not.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos de prata|cem talentos de prata}}
decisions.reason: The units setting gives kilograms by default, where the English gives pounds, at the 34 kilograms to the talent of the Old Testament terms, with the talents as the alternative; Literal keeps "cem talentos". "Valentes de guerra" (L) and "guerreiros valentes" (B) as 13:3 has them in Portuguese (m3).

decisions.choice: {{units:3,400 ኪሎ ያህል ብር|መቶ መክሊት ብር}} (Balanced, Readable); Literal keeps "መቶ መክሊት ብር".
decisions.reason: Amharic readers use metric weights; the talent is reckoned at 34 kilos, as the Kings and Chronicles terms list, and the original unit is the alternative, as 27:5.

decisions.choice: {{units:लगभग 3,400 किलो चाँदी|100 तालन्त चाँदी}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default where the English converts, the talent as the alternative (Pentateuch note: talent 34 kg), as 1 Kings in this translation; Literal keeps the talent, as the English Literal does. The same in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "{{units:около 3,4 тонны серебра|сто талантов серебра}}"
decisions.reason: Metric by default with the talent (34 kg) as the alternative, where the English converts to pounds; Literal keeps the talent.

decisions.choice: Units span "銀{{units:約3.4トン|百キカル}}": metric by default (1 kikkar about 34 kg), the talent as the alternative; Literal keeps "銀百キカル".
decisions.reason: Japanese settings give metric measures (style guide 7), as 2 Kings 23:33.

decisions.choice: gibbor chayil "力ある勇士" (L, B), "勇敢な戦士" (R).
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 12 and 26.

source.text: וְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַמֶּ֕לֶךְ אַל־יָבֹ֥א עִמְּךָ֖ צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] man of the God came to him, saying, O king, let not go with you [the] army of Israel, for not [is] Yahweh with Israel, all [the] sons of Ephraim.

en.L: And a man of God came to him, saying, "O king, let not the army of Israel go with you, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] not with Israel, all the sons of Ephraim.
en.B: But a man of God came to him and said, "O king, the army of Israel must not go with you, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is not with Israel, with any of the people of Ephraim.
en.R: But a man of God came to Amaziah and said, "Your Majesty, do not let the army from Israel go with you. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is not with Israel, with any of those people from Ephraim.

es.L: Y un hombre de Dios vino a él, diciendo: «Oh rey, que no vaya contigo el ejército de Israel, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no [está] con Israel, con todos los hijos de Efraín.
es.B: Pero un hombre de Dios vino a él y le dijo: «Oh rey, que no vaya contigo el ejército de Israel, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no está con Israel, con ninguno de los de Efraín.
es.R: Pero un hombre de Dios fue a ver a Amasías y le dijo: «Mi rey, no dejes que el ejército de Israel vaya contigo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no está con Israel, con ninguna de esas personas de Efraín.

fr.L: Et un homme de Dieu vint à lui et dit : « Ô roi, que l’armée d’Israël n’aille pas avec toi, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’[est] pas avec Israël, tous les fils d’Éphraïm.
fr.B: Mais un homme de Dieu vint lui dire : « Ô roi, l’armée d’Israël ne doit pas aller avec toi, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est pas avec Israël, avec aucun des gens d’Éphraïm.
fr.R: Mais un homme de Dieu est venu dire à Amatsia : « Ô roi, ne laisse pas l’armée d’Israël partir avec toi. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est pas avec Israël, avec aucun de ces gens d’Éphraïm.

sw.L: Lakini mtu wa Mungu akaja kwake, akisema, "Ee mfalme, jeshi la Israeli lisiende pamoja nawe, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [hayuko] pamoja na Israeli, wana wote wa Efraimu.
sw.B: Lakini mtu wa Mungu alimjia akasema, "Ee mfalme, jeshi la Israeli lisiende pamoja nawe, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko pamoja na Israeli, pamoja na yeyote wa watu wa Efraimu.
sw.R: Lakini mtu wa Mungu alimjia Amazia akasema, "Mtukufu mfalme, usiliache jeshi kutoka Israeli liende pamoja nawe. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko pamoja na Israeli, pamoja na yeyote wa watu hao wa Efraimu.

vi.L: Có một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến với vua mà nói: "Tâu vua, đừng để quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên đi với vua, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không [ở] với Y-sơ-ra-ên, với tất cả con cháu Ép-ra-im.
vi.B: Nhưng có một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến với vua và nói: "Tâu vua, đừng để quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên đi với vua, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không ở với Y-sơ-ra-ên, không ở với bất cứ người Ép-ra-im nào.
vi.R: Nhưng có một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến với A-ma-xia và nói: "Thưa đức vua, xin đừng để quân Y-sơ-ra-ên đi với vua. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không ở với Y-sơ-ra-ên, không ở với bất cứ ai trong đám người Ép-ra-im ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 사람이 그에게 와서 말했다. "왕이시여, 이스라엘 군대가 임금님과 함께 가지 않게 하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘, 곧 에브라임의 모든 자손과 함께 계시지 않기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님의 사람이 그에게 와서 말했다. "임금님, 이스라엘 군대가 임금님과 함께 가서는 안 됩니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘, 곧 에브라임 사람들 누구와도 함께 계시지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님의 사람이 아마샤에게 와서 말했다. "임금님, 이스라엘에서 온 군대를 데리고 가지 마십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘, 곧 에브라임 사람들 누구와도 함께하지 않으십니다.

pt.L: E um homem de Deus veio a ele, dizendo: "Ó rei, que não vá com você o exército de Israel, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não [está] com Israel, [com] todos os filhos de Efraim.
pt.B: Mas um homem de Deus veio a ele e disse: "Ó rei, o exército de Israel não deve ir com você, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não está com Israel, com ninguém do povo de Efraim.
pt.R: Mas um homem de Deus foi falar com Amazias e disse: "Ó rei, não deixe o exército de Israel ir com você. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não está com Israel, com nenhuma daquela gente de Efraim.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለ፦ «ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ የእስራኤል ሠራዊት ከአንተ ጋር አይሂድ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል፣ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ሁሉ ጋር አይደለምና።
am.B: ነገር ግን አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለው፦ «ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ የእስራኤል ሠራዊት ከአንተ ጋር መሄድ የለበትም፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ጋር፣ ከኤፍሬም ሰዎች ከአንዳቸውም ጋር አይደለምና።
am.R: ነገር ግን አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ አሜስያስ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለው፦ «ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ የእስራኤል ሠራዊት ከአንተ ጋር እንዲሄድ አትፍቀድ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ጋር፣ ከእነዚያ የኤፍሬም ሰዎች ከአንዳቸውም ጋር አይደለም።

hi.L: और परमेश्वर का एक जन उसके पास आया और कहा, "हे राजा, इस्राएल की सेना आपके साथ न जाए, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल के, अर्थात् एप्रैम के सब पुत्रों के, साथ नहीं [हैं]।
hi.B: पर परमेश्वर का एक जन उसके पास आया और कहा, "हे राजा, इस्राएल की सेना आपके साथ न जाए, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल के साथ नहीं हैं, एप्रैम के किसी भी व्यक्ति के साथ नहीं।
hi.R: पर परमेश्वर का एक जन अमस्याह के पास आया और कहा, "महाराज, इस्राएल की सेना को अपने साथ मत ले जाइए। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल के साथ नहीं हैं, एप्रैम के उन लोगों में से किसी के भी साथ नहीं।

ru.L: И пришёл к нему человек Божий, говоря: «Царь, пусть не идёт с тобой войско Израиля, потому что не с Израилем {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, [не] со всеми сыновьями Ефрема.
ru.B: Но к нему пришёл человек Божий и сказал: «Царь, войско Израиля не должно идти с тобой, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не с Израилем, ни с кем из ефремлян.
ru.R: Но к Амасии пришёл человек Божий и сказал: «Царь, не бери с собой израильское войско. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не с Израилем, ни с кем из этих людей из Ефрема.

ja.L: しかし、神の人が彼のもとに来て言った。「王よ、イスラエルの軍をあなたと共に行かせてはなりません。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はイスラエル、すなわちエフライムの子らのすべてと共にはおられないからです。
ja.B: しかし、ひとりの神の人が彼のもとに来て言った。「王さま、イスラエルの軍隊をあなたと一緒に行かせてはなりません。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエル、エフライムの人々のだれとも共におられないからです。
ja.R: ところが、ひとりの神の人がアマツヤのところに来て言いました。「王さま、イスラエルから来た軍隊を、一緒に連れて行ってはいけません。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエル、つまりエフライムから来たあの人たちのだれとも、共におられないからです。

uk.L: І прийшов до нього Божий чоловік, кажучи: «Царю, нехай не йде з тобою військо Ізраїля, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не з Ізраїлем, з усіма синами Ефраїма.
uk.B: Але до нього прийшов Божий чоловік і сказав: «Царю, військо Ізраїля не повинно йти з тобою, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не з Ізраїлем, ні з ким з людей Ефраїма.
uk.R: Але до Амації прийшов Божий чоловік і сказав: «Царю, не дозволяй війську з Ізраїлю йти з тобою. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не з Ізраїлем, ні з ким з тих людей з Ефраїма.

decisions.choice: a man of God: a prophet
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks for God (1 Samuel 2:27; 1 Kings 13:1). He is not named.

decisions.choice: Yahweh is not with Israel
decisions.reason: The northern kingdom had left Yahweh for the calves of Jeroboam (13:8-9). To fight with its army would be to lean on people Yahweh was not with, and the battle would be lost (verse 8). Chronicles teaches the same lesson in 16:7-9 and 19:2.

decisions.choice: all the sons of Ephraim: the northern kingdom by its leading tribe
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the strongest tribe of the north, and its name stands for the whole northern kingdom (Isaiah 7:2; Hosea 5:3).

decisions.choice: O king (Balanced); Your Majesty (Readable); the people of Ephraim
decisions.reason: Readable uses the modern form of address to a king. "Sons of Ephraim" is "people of Ephraim" at Balanced and Readable, since a whole people is meant. The speech goes on in verse 8.

decisions.choice: "Oh rey" (L, B); "Mi rey" (R)
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "Your Majesty", Spanish says "mi rey", as the Samuel note sets it, since "Majestad" would call for "usted".

decisions.choice: "Ô roi" at Readable for the English "Your Majesty"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note and French 1 Kings 12-22: the vocative "Ô roi" with "tu"; French Bibles have no "Majesté".

decisions.choice: "Tâu vua" (L, B); "Thưa đức vua" (R)
decisions.reason: A prophet addressing the king calls him "vua"; the respectful particle carries the Hebrew "O king". Readable uses the subjects' "đức vua" where the English says "Your Majesty".

decisions.choice: o homem de Deus; Ó rei (every level); você (the prophet to the king)
decisions.reason: "Homem de Deus" is the prophet's title (m1), as 1 Kings 13:1 has it in Portuguese. He speaks to the king with "você", as the prophets do in Kings and in this book (16:7), so Readable says "Ó rei", as Literal and Balanced do: the English Readable's "Your Majesty" would call for "Vossa Majestade" and the courtly third person, which does not go with a prophet's "você".

decisions.choice: The man of God says "ንጉሥ ሆይ" and "አንተ" to the king; "man of God" is "የእግዚአብሔር ሰው".
decisions.reason: A prophet bringing God's word to a king says "አንተ", as the terms list rules; "ንጉሥ ሆይ" keeps the plain vocative of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर का जन"; "हे राजा" (L, B), "महाराज" (R); "आप"
decisions.reason: The man of God as the history-books note; a prophet says आप to the king, and Readable says "महाराज" where the English Readable has "Your Majesty".

decisions.choice: The unnamed man of God speaks to the king in です・ます, "王よ" (L), "王さま" (B, R); Amaziah answers plain.
decisions.reason: As the unnamed prophets before Ahab in 1 Kings 20 (1KI-consistency); the named prophets keep plain speech.

source.text: כִּ֚י אִם־בֹּ֣א אַתָּ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה חֲזַ֣ק לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה יַכְשִֽׁילְךָ֤ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־כֹּ֛חַ בֵּאלֹהִ֖ים לַעְז֥וֹר וּלְהַכְשִֽׁיל׃

records.literal_gloss: But if go you, act, be strong for the battle, will make stumble you the God before [the] enemy, for there [is] power in God to help and to make stumble.

en.L: But if you go, act, be strong for the battle, God will make you stumble before [the] enemy; for there is power in God to help and to make [one] stumble."
en.B: Even if you go and fight, and are strong in battle, God will cast you down before the enemy, for God has power to help and to cast down."
en.R: If you go anyway and fight bravely, God will let your enemy defeat you. God has the power to help, and the power to make people fall."

es.L: Pero si vas tú, hazlo, esfuérzate para la batalla: Dios te hará tropezar delante del enemigo, porque en Dios hay poder para ayudar y para hacer tropezar».
es.B: Aunque vayas y pelees, y te muestres fuerte en la batalla, Dios te derribará delante del enemigo, porque Dios tiene poder para ayudar y para derribar».
es.R: Si vas de todos modos y peleas con valentía, Dios dejará que tu enemigo te venza. Dios tiene poder para ayudar, y también poder para hacer caer».

fr.L: Mais si tu y vas, agis, sois fort pour la bataille, Dieu te fera trébucher devant l’ennemi ; car il y a en Dieu la force d’aider et de faire trébucher. »
fr.B: Même si tu y vas et que tu combats vaillamment, Dieu te fera tomber devant l’ennemi, car Dieu a le pouvoir d’aider et de faire tomber. »
fr.R: Si tu y vas quand même et que tu combats avec courage, Dieu laissera ton ennemi te vaincre. Dieu a le pouvoir d’aider, et il a le pouvoir de faire tomber les gens. »

sw.L: Lakini ukienda, fanya, uwe hodari kwa vita, Mungu atakukwaza mbele ya adui; kwa maana kwa Mungu kuna uwezo wa kusaidia na wa kukwaza."
sw.B: Hata ukienda ukapigana, ukawa hodari vitani, Mungu atakuangusha mbele ya adui, kwa maana Mungu ana uwezo wa kusaidia na wa kuangusha."
sw.R: Hata ukienda ukapigana kwa ushujaa, Mungu atamwacha adui yako akushinde. Mungu ana uwezo wa kusaidia, na uwezo wa kuwaangusha watu."

vi.L: Nhưng nếu vua đi, cứ hành động, hãy mạnh mẽ trong trận chiến, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ làm cho vua vấp ngã trước kẻ thù; vì Đức Chúa Trời có quyền năng để giúp đỡ và để làm cho vấp ngã."
vi.B: Dù vua có đi và chiến đấu, có mạnh mẽ trong trận chiến, Đức Chúa Trời cũng sẽ làm cho vua ngã gục trước kẻ thù, vì Đức Chúa Trời có quyền giúp đỡ và có quyền làm cho ngã gục."
vi.R: Nếu vua vẫn cứ đi và chiến đấu dũng cảm, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ để kẻ thù đánh bại vua. Đức Chúa Trời có quyền giúp đỡ, và cũng có quyền làm cho người ta ngã."

ko.L: 그러나 임금님께서 가시겠다면, 행하시고 싸움에 강하게 되십시오. 하나님께서 원수 앞에서 임금님을 넘어지게 하실 것입니다. 하나님께는 돕기도 하시고 넘어지게도 하시는 능력이 있기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 임금님께서 가셔서 용감하게 싸우신다 해도, 하나님께서 원수 앞에서 임금님을 넘어뜨리실 것입니다. 하나님께는 도우실 능력도 있고 넘어뜨리실 능력도 있습니다."
ko.R: 임금님께서 그래도 가셔서 용감하게 싸우신다면, 하나님께서는 원수가 임금님을 이기게 하실 것입니다. 하나님께는 사람을 도우실 힘도 있고, 넘어지게 하실 힘도 있습니다."

pt.L: Mas, se você for, aja, seja forte para a batalha, Deus o fará tropeçar diante do inimigo; porque há poder em Deus para ajudar e para fazer tropeçar."
pt.B: Mesmo que você vá e lute, e seja forte na batalha, Deus o derrubará diante do inimigo, pois Deus tem poder para ajudar e para derrubar."
pt.R: Se você for mesmo assim e lutar com coragem, Deus vai deixar que o inimigo derrote você. Deus tem poder para ajudar e poder para fazer cair."

am.L: አንተ ግን ብትሄድ፣ አድርግ፤ ለሰልፉ በርታ፤ እግዚአብሔር በጠላት ፊት ያሰናክልሃል፤ ለመርዳትና ለማሰናከል በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ኃይል አለና።»
am.B: ብትሄድና በጦርነቱ ብትበረታ እንኳ እግዚአብሔር በጠላት ፊት ይጥልሃል፤ እግዚአብሔር ለመርዳትም ለመጣልም ኃይል አለውና።»
am.R: ብትሄድና በጀግንነት ብትዋጋ እንኳ እግዚአብሔር ጠላትህ እንዲያሸንፍህ ያደርጋል። እግዚአብሔር ለመርዳትም ሰዎችን ለመጣልም ኃይል አለው።»

hi.L: पर यदि आप जाएँ, काम करें, युद्ध के लिए दृढ़ हों, तो भी परमेश्वर आपको शत्रु के सामने ठोकर खिलाएँगे; क्योंकि सहायता करने और ठोकर खिलाने का सामर्थ्य परमेश्वर में है।"
hi.B: चाहे आप जाकर लड़ें और युद्ध में बलवान भी हों, तो भी परमेश्वर आपको शत्रु के सामने गिरा देंगे, क्योंकि परमेश्वर में सहायता करने और गिराने का सामर्थ्य है।"
hi.R: यदि आप फिर भी जाकर बहादुरी से लड़ें, तो भी परमेश्वर आपके शत्रु को आप पर जीत देंगे। परमेश्वर में सहायता करने का सामर्थ्य भी है और लोगों को गिराने का भी।"

ru.L: Если же пойдёшь ты, действуй, будь крепок в битве — Бог повергнет тебя перед врагом, потому что есть у Бога сила помочь и повергнуть.»
ru.B: Даже если ты пойдёшь и будешь сражаться храбро, Бог повергнет тебя перед врагом, потому что у Бога есть сила помочь и повергнуть.»
ru.R: Если ты всё же пойдёшь и будешь храбро сражаться, Бог отдаст тебя врагу. У Бога есть сила помочь, и есть сила сделать так, чтобы человек пал.»

ja.L: しかし、もしあなたが行くなら、行って、戦いのために強くなりなさい。[それでも]神は敵の前であなたをつまずかせられます。神には、助ける力も、つまずかせる力もあるからです。」
ja.B: たとえあなたが出て行って戦い、勇ましく戦ったとしても、神はあなたを敵の前で倒されます。神には、助ける力も、倒す力もあるからです。」
ja.R: それでも出かけて行って、勇ましく戦ったとしても、神は、あなたが敵に負けるようにされます。神には、助ける力も、人を倒す力もあるのです。」

uk.L: А якщо ти підеш, дій, будь сильним до бою, — Бог змусить тебе спіткнутися перед ворогом; бо є в Бога сила допомогти і змусити спіткнутися.»
uk.B: Навіть якщо ти підеш і битимешся, і будеш сильним у бою, Бог повалить тебе перед ворогом, бо Бог має силу допомогти і повалити.»
uk.R: Якщо ти все одно підеш і хоробро битимешся, Бог дасть твоєму ворогові перемогти тебе. Бог має силу допомогти, і силу змусити людей упасти.»

decisions.choice: if you go, act, be strong: even if you fight bravely, you will lose
alternatives: but go yourself, act, be strong for battle (a call to go without the hired troops)
if you think to be strong by these
decisions.reason: The commands "act, be strong" are said with irony: however bravely Amaziah fights with the hired army, God will bring him down. The Greek translation and some interpreters read the line differently, as "if you think to be strong with these", which changes a few letters; the sense of the warning is the same.

decisions.choice: God has power to help and to cast down
decisions.reason: The outcome of the battle lies with God, not with the size of the army, a lesson Chronicles teaches often (14:10; 20:6; 1 Chronicles 29:12). The same verb, "make stumble", ends both halves of the verse.

decisions.choice: make you stumble before the enemy: give you defeat
decisions.reason: To stumble or fall before an enemy is to be beaten by him in battle (Leviticus 26:37).

decisions.choice: cast down (Balanced); let your enemy defeat you; make people fall (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses one verb for both uses of the Hebrew verb, as the Hebrew does. Readable says plainly what the warning means. Balanced and Readable render the commands as an "even if" or "anyway" clause, following m1.

decisions.choice: "derribará ... derribar"
decisions.reason: Balanced uses one verb for both uses of the Hebrew verb, as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: fazer tropeçar (L), derrubar (B), fazer cair (R) for both uses of the verb
decisions.reason: The verse ends both halves with one verb (m2), and Literal and Balanced each repeat one Portuguese verb for it, as the English does; Readable says what the warning means and keeps "cair" for the second use.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמַֽה־לַּעֲשׂוֹת֙ לִמְאַ֣ת הַכִּכָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִגְד֣וּד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵ֚שׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לָ֥תֶת לְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מִזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Amaziah to [the] man of the God, And what [is there] to do for the hundred talent[s] which I have given to [the] troop of Israel? And said [the] man of the God, There is to Yahweh to give to you much more than this.

en.L: And Amaziah said to the man of God, "And what [is there] to do about the 100 talents that I have given to the troop of Israel?" And the man of God said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has [the means] to give you much more than this."
en.B: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about the silver I have paid to the troops of Israel, the {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}}?" The man of God answered, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is able to give you much more than that."
en.R: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about all the silver I paid to the soldiers from Israel? It was {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}}!" The man of God answered, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} can give you much more than that."

es.L: Y Amasías dijo al hombre de Dios: «¿Y qué [se ha de] hacer con los cien talentos que he dado a la tropa de Israel?». Y el hombre de Dios dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene [con qué] darte mucho más que esto».
es.B: Amasías le preguntó al hombre de Dios: «¿Y qué pasa con la plata que les pagué a las tropas de Israel, los {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}}?». El hombre de Dios respondió: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} puede darte mucho más que eso».
es.R: Amasías le preguntó al hombre de Dios: «¿Y qué pasa con toda la plata que les pagué a los soldados de Israel? ¡Fueron {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}}!». El hombre de Dios respondió: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} puede darte mucho más que eso».

fr.L: Et Amatsia dit à l’homme de Dieu : « Et que faire au sujet des cent talents que j’ai donnés à la troupe d’Israël ? » Et l’homme de Dieu dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a [de quoi] te donner beaucoup plus que cela. »
fr.B: Amatsia demanda à l’homme de Dieu : « Mais que devient l’argent que j’ai versé aux troupes d’Israël, les {{units:3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} ? » L’homme de Dieu répondit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} peut te donner beaucoup plus que cela. »
fr.R: Amatsia a demandé à l’homme de Dieu : « Mais que devient tout l’argent que j’ai payé aux soldats d’Israël ? C’étaient {{units:3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} ! » L’homme de Dieu a répondu : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} peut te donner beaucoup plus que cela. »

sw.L: Amazia akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Na [tufanye] nini kuhusu talanta 100 nilizowapa kikosi cha Israeli?" Naye mtu wa Mungu akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana [uwezo] wa kukupa zaidi sana kuliko hizo."
sw.B: Amazia akamwuliza mtu wa Mungu, "Lakini je, fedha niliyowalipa askari wa Israeli, ile {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}}?" Mtu wa Mungu akajibu, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaweza kukupa zaidi sana kuliko hiyo."
sw.R: Amazia akamwuliza mtu wa Mungu, "Lakini je, fedha yote niliyowalipa askari kutoka Israeli? Ilikuwa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}}!" Mtu wa Mungu akajibu, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaweza kukupa zaidi sana kuliko hiyo."

vi.L: A-ma-xia nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Vậy phải làm sao về một trăm ta-lâng mà ta đã trả cho toán quân Y-sơ-ra-ên?" Người của Đức Chúa Trời đáp: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có [thể] ban cho vua nhiều hơn thế nữa."
vi.B: A-ma-xia hỏi người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Nhưng còn số bạc ta đã trả cho quân Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg|một trăm ta-lâng}} ấy thì sao?" Người của Đức Chúa Trời đáp: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể ban cho vua nhiều hơn thế nữa."
vi.R: A-ma-xia hỏi người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Nhưng còn bao nhiêu bạc ta đã trả cho quân lính Y-sơ-ra-ên thì sao? Đến {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg|một trăm ta-lâng}} đấy!" Người của Đức Chúa Trời đáp: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể ban cho vua nhiều hơn thế nữa."

ko.L: 그리고 아마샤가 하나님의 사람에게 말했다. "그러면 내가 이스라엘 부대에게 준 100달란트는 어떻게 하란 말이오?" 그리고 하나님의 사람이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께는 이보다 훨씬 많은 것을 임금님께 주실 [능력이] 있습니다."
ko.B: 아마샤가 하나님의 사람에게 물었다. "그러면 내가 이스라엘 군대에게 준 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에 이르는 은은 어떻게 하란 말이오?" 하나님의 사람이 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그보다 훨씬 많은 것을 임금님께 주실 수 있습니다."
